While I have no great condemnation in my heart towards the practice of gambling, I do find it curious and somewhat disagreeable that it should be within the World Assembly Headquarters. Could this proposal not be amended to merely include such a method of funding (the casino and the like) be kept on a separate property? I will raise such a concern although I fear it is now far too late to render an opinion.

Now of course regardless of the impact of my opinion I feel it is the just and righteous course to thoroughly outline it that all might know it. I do however encourage those who are completely against or completely in favor this proposal to restate or state their points that I might see the merits and/or failings of both and potentially be convinced as to the errors or soundness of my ways.

@Wallenburg I apologize for contacting you in so direct a manner but I could not help but note your quite spirited opposition to the proposal, in this channel and on the original forum thread. If and when possible I would like to hear the reasoning behind such opposition, for I am interested in you espousing your beliefs and clarifying them further.

Should you not wish to be pinged in such a way, or at all, I offer my ignorance as a person who has just joined, not as an excuse but an explanation. Further I apologize should I have done you wrong in undertaking this and shall not repeat it, if that be your desire.

Both Wallenburg the nation and the player behind it consider gambling among the worst institutions humans have conceived of. The industrial exploitation of fools and addicts by systems that guarantee loss in the long run is just glorified theft.
For a government not only to permit it to ruin the lives of its stakeholders but to actively encourage it and profit from it is unforgivable.
